theme_strategy.rationale: A modern, bright, friendly, and trustworthy sports-app aesthetic (similar to Dream11 / FanCode). Avoids the dark, heavy casino look. Emphasizes clean spaces, soft neutrals, and energetic sports-inspired accent colors.

headings.usage: Use tight tracking (tracking-tight) for all headings. The main greeting on Home and Wallet Balance should be prominent.

body.usage: Use leading-relaxed for any descriptive text or disclaimers.

layouts_and_grids.global: Full-width responsive layout. The container should expand gracefully on desktop (max-w-7xl mx-auto) instead of being constrained to a mobile phone frame. Use generous padding (px-6 md:px-12 lg:px-24) to keep it airy and uncluttered.
layouts_and_grids.bento_strategy: On desktop, arrange the Home sections using a Bento Grid approach (e.g., grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 or gap-8). For example, place the Balance Card and Quick Actions side-by-side on desktop.
layouts_and_grids.mobile: Mobile-first vertical stack, but ensure large tap targets and soft spacing (gap-6) between distinct sections.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Use soft, ambient shadows for cards to make them float off the neutral background: shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]
visual_enhancers.radii: Use rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for major cards to enhance the friendly, modern feel.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Apply to the bottom navigation bar and any sticky headers (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-t border-slate-100).
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise or clean gradient meshes inside the Coin Balance Card and Fantasy Promo Banner to give them a premium 'hero' feel without being loud.

motion_and_interactions.page_load: Awwwards-level kinetic reveal: Use Framer Motion for a line-by-line masked reveal on the Home greeting and Wallet total balance.
motion_and_interactions.scroll: Implement Lenis smooth scrolling for a premium, heavy momentum feel.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Game lobby tiles and quick action buttons should have a slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow expansion on hover.
motion_and_interactions.parallax: The Fantasy Contest Promo Banner should feature a subtle image parallax effect inside its rounded container as the user scrolls.

bottom_nav.layout: Fixed at the bottom. Glassmorphism effect. Evenly spaced 5 icons (Home, Sports, Fantasy, Games, Wallet) with labels.
bottom_nav.behavior: Only Home and Wallet need to be functional for this scope.

home_screen.header: Greeting text + Notification Bell + User Avatar.
home_screen.coin_balance_card: A large, premium card with a subtle gradient (Indigo to Violet), showing Coin Balance, '+X today' in a success pill, and 'View Wallet' / 'Earn Coins' actions.
home_screen.quick_actions: A row or grid of circular/rounded-square icons (Sports, Fantasy, Games, Rewards).
home_screen.live_now: Horizontal scrolling container (hide scrollbar) featuring 2 live match cards (e.g., Cricket and Football) with real images, team names, and 'Live' pulsating badge.
home_screen.fantasy_promo: A wide, visually striking banner with a background image, dark/indigo overlay, bold text ('Mega Contest Live'), and a prominent 'Join' CTA.
home_screen.games_lobby: A grid (grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-6) of 6 tiles. Each tile has an icon (Lucide) and name (Teen Patti, Poker, Roulette, Aviator, Ludo, Call Break).
home_screen.daily_streak: A horizontal strip/card showing login days and a 'Claim' button.

wallet_screen.total_balance: Massive typography for the balance amount, paired with the exact disclaimer: 'Virtual entertainment coins only — no real-money value, not withdrawable or redeemable for cash.'
wallet_screen.stats_tiles: A 3-column grid showing 'Earned this week', 'Spent this week', and 'Rewards claimed'.
wallet_screen.action_buttons: Two large, prominent buttons: 'How to Earn' (outline/secondary) and 'Redeem' (solid/primary).
wallet_screen.transaction_history: A clean list of 5 sample items (e.g., 'Daily Login', 'Joined Fantasy', 'Played Ludo'). Use color-coded amounts (+ in green, - in red/slate) and relative timestamps.

live_match_cricket.description: Cricket stadium sunset for live match card

live_match_football.description: Football action for live match card

fantasy_promo_bg.description: Silhouette player kicking soccer ball on field at sunset for the background of the fantasy promo banner

libraries_and_dependencies: framer-motion (for scroll reveals, kinetic hero animations, and micro-interactions)
lucide-react (for sleek, consistent icons in games lobby and UI)

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for text on all backgrounds. The disclaimer text in the Wallet must be clearly readable, not washed out.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, nav items, cards acting as links) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='nav-wallet-button', data-testid='claim-streak-btn').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not constrain the app into a mobile phone frame (e.g. max-w-sm mx-auto). It must be a FULL-WIDTH responsive layout (max-w-7xl mx-auto) that looks expansive and airy on desktop.
Do not use dark backgrounds for the overall page; strictly adhere to the light/soft-neutral strategy.
Implement the 'Awwwards-level' motion: use framer-motion to reveal the main headers line-by-line, and apply a parallax effect to the Fantasy Promo banner image.
Ensure 'data-testid' is attached to every single button and interactive element.
Do not use generic 'inter' for headers. Import Outfit and Manrope via Google Fonts in index.css or index.html.
The games lobby tiles should use Lucide icons (e.g., Spade, Club, Circle/Roulette, Plane/Aviator, Grid/Ludo) with clear names and soft background tints, avoiding messy images for the icons.
Ensure generous spacing: use py-12 or py-16 between major sections on desktop, scaling to py-8 on mobile.
